title: One bedroom and a study
lede: A one-bedroom layout with a separate study, in the north–south terrace blocks.
body: The flat runs from the front of the building to the back. The rooms fit around the stairs and lift, next to a two-bedroom Type 21.

title: Two bedrooms
lede: A two-bedroom flat that fits alongside Type 20.
body: The second bedroom sits behind the stairwell. These flats run from front to back in Andrewes, Defoe, Speed and Thomas More houses.

title: Entrance through the living room
lede: A one-bedroom flat in the east–west terraces.
body: The front door opens from the shared corridor into the living area. Type 31 has a similar layout, but its entrance opens into a hall.

title: Entrance through a hall
lede: A one-bedroom flat in Gilbert, Mountjoy and Seddon houses.
body: The front door opens into a hall beside the bathroom. In Type 26, it opens straight into the living area.

title: A penthouse on two floors
lede: A three-bedroom penthouse arranged over two floors.
body: The living room has a double-height ceiling. Stairs lead to a landing overlooking it, with bedrooms upstairs and a roof patio outside.
